label: M1sim_mode2_lucky_mid
_note: 2026-04-22 v2 rewrite: shifted the bucket shape so RTP *contribution* centers on the mid-multiplier buckets (10-50×) instead of the high tail (50-500×).
v1 (tail-heavy) produced CV 6.04 and 63% of RTP came from 50-500× buckets — 'lucky mode' but boom-bust: each player's experience was dominated by a few rare big hits.
v2 keeps user constraints (hit 25-30%, RTP ≈ 300%) but redistributes so:
Mid (10-50×):       59% of RTP (↑ from 24.5%, new center)
High (50-500×):     16% of RTP (↓ from 63.2%, tail compressed)
sum RTP = 291pp ≈ 300pp target (rtp_pct field 291 lets tuner converge here; 280-310 range OK per user 2026-04-22)
Expected CV ≈ 3.1 (vs v1's 6.04, halved) — std_return_x ≈ 9 (vs 18.5). Player sees frequent mid-multiplier hits instead of rare big spikes.

Structural path for tuner: compress Diamond2 reel 2 mass (was 142 in v1 — huge wild3x spike source), boost Bar/Seven 3-of-a-kind frequencies to fill mid buckets. Tuner has been given --cv-weight 1.0 (3x default) + --shape-weight 2.0 (2x default) + --hit-weight 1.5 to enforce this balance.
